## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A local interactive session runs uv run, pytest, git read commands and...

The system SHALL ensure that a local interactive session runs uv run, pytest, git read commands and worktree-scoped writes with no approval prompt.

#### Scenario: A local interactive session runs uv run, pytest, git read commands and...

WHEN `sandbox-the-interactive-lead-session` is implemented
THEN A local interactive session runs uv run, pytest, git read commands and worktree-scoped writes with no approval prompt.

### Requirement: A sandboxed command cannot read ~/.ssh, ~/.aws or another repository's...

The system SHALL ensure that a sandboxed command cannot read ~/.ssh, ~/.aws or another repository's checkout; a test demonstrates the denial.

#### Scenario: A sandboxed command cannot read ~/.ssh, ~/.aws or another repository's...

WHEN `sandbox-the-interactive-lead-session` is implemented
THEN A sandboxed command cannot read ~/.ssh, ~/.aws or another repository's checkout; a test demonstrates the denial.

### Requirement: Every command class in the irreversible set still prompts or is denied,...

The system SHALL ensure that every command class in the irreversible set still prompts or is denied, verified by a test that enumerates the set.

#### Scenario: Every command class in the irreversible set still prompts or is denied,...

WHEN `sandbox-the-interactive-lead-session` is implemented
THEN Every command class in the irreversible set still prompts or is denied, verified by a test that enumerates the set.

### Requirement: The allow list in .claude/settings.json shrinks, and the guide on writing...

The system SHALL ensure that the allow list in .claude/settings.json shrinks, and the guide on writing matchable Bash commands is updated to match.

#### Scenario: The allow list in .claude/settings.json shrinks, and the guide on writing...

WHEN `sandbox-the-interactive-lead-session` is implemented
THEN The allow list in .claude/settings.json shrinks, and the guide on writing matchable Bash commands is updated to match.

### Requirement: Under the managed cloud harness, which provides its own sandbox and proxy,...

The system SHALL ensure that under the managed cloud harness, which provides its own sandbox and proxy, local sandbox wrapping is detected as unnecessary and skipped.

#### Scenario: Under the managed cloud harness, which provides its own sandbox and proxy,...

WHEN `sandbox-the-interactive-lead-session` is implemented
THEN Under the managed cloud harness, which provides its own sandbox and proxy, local sandbox wrapping is detected as unnecessary and skipped.
